symptom: Fill opacity on a text-containing layer with a painted background wrote the text colour alpha instead of the background alpha.
rule: A text layer keeps Fill on lettering only while it has no authored painted background; an authored background remains the fill target even at zero opacity.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/design-workspace/__tests__/design-fill-destructive-edits.test.ts -t 'writes fill opacity to the background of a text-containing layer, not its text color'
